keyPoints: Number line par 0 ke daayein positive sankhyaen, baayein negative.
Jod: same sign ho to jodo aur wahi sign rakho (-3 + -2 = -5); alag sign ho to ghatao aur badi sankhya ka sign lo (-5 + 3 = -2).
Guna/bhaag: same sign = positive jawab, alag sign = negative jawab. (-4) x (-5) = 20, (-6) / 3 = -2.
BODMAS yaad rakho: pehle bracket, phir guna-bhaag, phir jod-ghata.
Rozmarra me: -2°C temperature, bank me -500 ka matlab udhaar.
